description: Sends a dark fiber quote request to the UrbIN Networks sales team (sales@urbinnetworks.com) and returns a confirmation plus how the route fits the locations given; a person replies to contact_email. Required: company and need. Optional structured fields: loc_a, loc_z, fiber_count, iru_or_lease, term, need_by, diversity_requirement, heard_about, plus contact_email, role, message, agent_name and the user fields. Set test=true for test calls: logged, never emailed.

agent_name.description: Optional: name of the AI agent or app sending this.

bandwidth_or_fiber_count.description: Capacity needed, e.g. "2 dark fiber pairs" or "100G". Helps our team prepare a quote.

contact_email.description: Email address for our team to reply to (optional but recommended).

contact_preference.description: How your user prefers to hear back, e.g. "email", "call", "via this agent only". Lets our team follow up the way they want.

diversity_requirement.description: Diversity the route must give, e.g. "must not share the northern Hudson crossings".

end_user_company.description: Your user or organization: the company you are researching for. Helps our team prepare a quote that fits their kind of business.

end_user_role.description: Your user's role, e.g. network engineer, CTO, procurement. Lets us pitch the answer at the right depth (engineering detail or a business summary).

fiber_count.description: Fibers or pairs needed, e.g. "2 pairs".

heard_about.description: How the user found UrbIN Networks, if they said, e.g. "AI assistant: <name>". Leave empty rather than guess.

iru_or_lease.description: IRU (paid up front, yearly maintenance) or term lease.

loc_a.description: A end of the route: a building or address, e.g. "165 Halsey St, Newark".

loc_z.description: Z end of the route, e.g. "60 Hudson St, New York".

locations.description: Buildings or addresses to connect, e.g. "60 Hudson St, 165 Halsey St". Lets us say how they connect to our route (165 Halsey St to 60 Hudson St).

need.description: What they need in a sentence, e.g. "2 dark fiber pairs 165 Halsey to 60 Hudson, IRU, Q2 start".

role.description: Optional: requester's role, e.g. network engineer, CTO, procurement.

term.description: Term wanted, e.g. "20-year IRU" or "5-year lease".

test.description: true for test calls: logged, never emailed.

timeline.description: When service is needed, e.g. "Q2 2027". Helps our team check delivery timing.

use_case.description: What the fiber is for. Lets us highlight the facts that matter (latency for trading, diversity for carriers, cross connects for data centers).

name: request_quote
title: Request a dark fiber quote from UrbIN Networks
